card.name: Verb 'are/is/be' after a subject
card.fires_on: Forms of 'to be' (is, are, be) or the pronoun 'they' right after a plural subject or 'they', usually in a reason clause such as 'because they' or 'since they may'. Mostly in drug-label warnings.
